name: v0.16.3
body:
# pdfcpu v0.16.3

This is a security update fixing configured decoded-byte limit bypasses and restricting local image access in create and form input.

**Applications handling untrusted PDFs or create/form input should upgrade.**

**Decoded-byte limits — [GHSA-jp42-qm45-2x6g](https://github.com/pdfcpu/pdfcpu/security/advisories/GHSA-jp42-qm45-2x6g):**

Honor `Limits.MaxDecodeBytes` across stream decoding and combined page content, and stop cross-reference repair after
limit failures. Strengthen Flate predictor, DCT and cached-content checks, with regression coverage for strict/relaxed
validation and eager/deferred decoding.

The limit bounds individual decoded streams and combined page content, not total process memory.

**Additive Go API change:** Add `StreamDict.DecodeWithLimit` and `StreamDict.DecodeLengthWithLimit` to supply the
configured decode limit explicitly.

**Local image access — [GHSA-44h9-p34h-2w4p](https://github.com/pdfcpu/pdfcpu/security/advisories/GHSA-44h9-p34h-2w4p):**

Confine local images referenced by `create`, `form fill`, and JSON/CSV `form multifill` input to an allowed directory.
Reject absolute paths, parent-directory components, symlink escapes and non-regular files, and report access denials
as errors.

**Compatibility change:** 
API callers must set `conf.LocalImageRoot` to enable local images; an empty value disables
them. The CLI defaults to its working directory; set `localImageRoot` in `config.yml` to select another root.
Update image paths to be relative to that root. Confined local images are unavailable on `js/wasm`.
See [local image access](https://pdfcpu.io/create/create/#local-image-access) for migration guidance and limitations.

**Documentation:** 
Updated [security policy](https://github.com/pdfcpu/pdfcpu/blob/v0.16.3/SECURITY.md) clarifies vulnerability scope, supported releases and guidance for AI-assisted reports and multiple findings. 
Updated [pull request template](https://github.com/pdfcpu/pdfcpu/blob/v0.16.3/.github/pull_request_template.md) clarifies contribution requirements.
Added local image configuration and migration guidance to README and website.

Requires Go 1.26 or later, unchanged from v0.16.2.

## Changelog
* 35ea259eb27d5a607f797edd41fd8a9e50a1f818 bump version
* 8befe54db401e8ed0ecb9d52aec700fa67b2972f confine local images in create and form input
* c1db2d55c0826689a129012fbac5a25d5fd3a39f honor configured decode limits across stream consumers
